post.description:
Refresh JWT access token using refresh token.

**Web Clients:** Send refresh token via cookie (automatic).

**Mobile Apps:** Send refresh token via `Authorization: Bearer <refreshToken>` header and set `X-Client-Type: mobile` to receive new tokens in response body.

**Token Lifetime:**
- Access Token: 8 hours
- Refresh Token: 7 days

parameters.name: X-Client-Type
parameters.description: Set to 'mobile' to receive tokens in response body
